title: Recover P via g=e(P0,Q) on the plain P10 GT STNFS core with the rec7 run rule and the 2^19 filtering campaign: 119.45141501147

claims.statement: For the production bls12-381-fixed-g2-invert-g1 target, the algorithm of proof.md returns P in G1 with e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied uniform nonidentity Q (z=1 gives P=infinity) with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins under the disclosed heuristics H1-H5 (proof.md section 9). It forms g=e(P0,Q) (uniform nonidentity, independent of the uniform target z: exactly the core's input distribution), converts g and z into the STNFS tower by the charged field map of field-map.md, computes a=log_g(z) with the GT STNFS core and returns P=[a]P0 after checking e(P,Q)=z. rec7 walks a listed run only if all its a-values are canonical, so every walked slice is charged; the remaining work on rows whose listed run is not all canonical is bounded by a cell-weighted exhaustive sample (720 rows, 266,656 a-values, 0 affected; 99.9% bound, count-corrected q <= 0.00986) times the enclosure of the per-cell saving, 47: reserve row 2^110.532; listed-run ends 2^75. The core is the GT core of our valid plain P10 9c904850, byte-identical: collection <= 2^119.180693087, linear algebra <= 2^116.775787663 (N(300)/U 0.03672 from the PREREG-G campaign at 2^18 and 2^19), generator <= 2^107.389731954, 62-node lazy descent metered at 2^113.104; core rows sum to at most 2^119.4484322952 dense-Fp12 units (C=20,000). Total classical work, including all preprocessing, both logarithms, failures, the field map, pairings, verification and output, is at most 2^119.4484322952 + 2^110.532 + 2^75 + 2^80/20000 < 2^119.45141501147 dense-Fp12 units (C=20,000). Peak storage below 2^106 bytes; no advice and no amortization. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Hosted audit: code identity, parameters, recorded full-run certificate, probes, lazy bound, core ledger and success, run rule, total with wrapper (80-digit). {"descent": true} reruns the descent recurrence.
Optional: filtsim at excess 1.05 and the shipped means to weight 100/200/300; reports the +-1 share of row weight (charged 0.87) and U/N. Toy scale only (H4u, H3).
Optional: {"mode":"dmax"} recomputes the enclosure U(S_min) and checks d <= U on a grid (about 1 minute); {"mode":"replay","seed":s} redraws a sample seed's first row and tests its whole run.
